findings.claim: The diff adds three browser-shared request modules under frontend/src/lib (listingRequest.ts, semanticSearchRequest.ts, addonStatusRequest.ts) that the touch-point list does not name; the list names only a single new server io module.
findings.impact: A reviewer or maintainer who scopes the change by the touch-point list could miss that getDriveFiles, fetchSemanticHits and getSemanticAvailability callers in the browser now run through these new files.
findings.evidence: Diff: the three paths are new files (frontend/src/lib/listingRequest.ts, frontend/src/lib/semanticSearchRequest.ts, frontend/src/lib/addonStatusRequest.ts). Spec Touch points lists 'a new server io module under frontend/src/lib/' and only the parenthetical '(builders and readers moved out)' on api.ts, semanticSearch.ts and addons.ts. Glob confirms the three files exist in the worktree.

bucket_proposal.reason: No declared invariant is broken; the touch-point list is incomplete, so the change reads as narrower than it is.

findings.proposed_fix: Name the three shared request modules explicitly in the spec's Touch points list.

specification_compliance: Every changed path outside docs/specs, docs/process/reviews and the spec ledger is inside the touch-point list, except the three shared request modules in frontend/src/lib that the list covers only by a parenthetical.
No protected path is edited in the diff.
test_coverage: The new frontend and mcp-server tests sit inside the listed test locations (frontend/src/app/app-api/__tests__, frontend/src/lib/__tests__, mcp-server/src/__tests__).
not_verified: I did not check whether the move_file and move_files descriptions were changed as SPEC-CORE-038 I12 requires; the diff shows no change there. This is a missing implementation and is outside this scope question.
I did not read the process rules in .claude/rules/process.md for a rule on naming new modules in touch points.
I did not check the frontend route tests or the mcp-server tests for correctness; only the file scope was compared.
